title: Matter wavelength scaling
statement:
A nonrelativistic particle’s speed increases fourfold at constant mass. What happens to its de Broglie wavelength?

[_]{a}

choices: It becomes one quarter as large.
explanations: This would make wavelength proportional to momentum.
No square root is used in this comparison.

hints: Wavelength is inversely proportional to momentum.
solution: Momentum is mv. Momentum quadruples. Wavelength is inversely proportional to momentum. λ=h/p.
